verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs describe built-in CI/CD via Pipelines with deployment environments, hosted/private runners, and environment-level permissions, indicating deployment automation is supported (docs-8, docs-9, docs-10, docs-13). However, all evidence is vendor-claimed with no community validation or hands-on confirmation of deployment automation specifically, and community comments focus on other aspects (UI, pricing) without addressing CI/CD deployment quality.
